###Pull Data:

# Load Perry data
data_frame <- read.csv("../Data/Full Profile Data/Perry Full-Profile SampleData Dev 2025.csv", header = TRUE, sep = ",")

###Data Wrangling:

```{r wrangling}
data_frame <- data_frame %>%
  clean_names %>% 
  dplyr::rename(id = sample_id_lab) %>% #rename to id
  dplyr::rename(hzid = horizon) %>% #rename to hzid
  mutate(top = as.numeric(sub("-.*", "", to_depth_cm)),  # Extracts top depth
    bottom = as.numeric(str_remove(sub(".*-", "", to_depth_cm), "\\+"))) 

texture_map <- c(
  "LS" = "loamy_sand",
  "SCL" = "sandy_clay_loam",
  "SL" = "sandy_loam",
  "L" = "loam",
  "CL" = "clay_loam",
  "S" = "sand",
  "C" = "clay",
  "SIL" = "silt_loam",
  "SI" = "silt",
  "SC" = "sandy_clay",
  "C " = "clay")

# Replace texture abbreviations with full names
data_frame <- data_frame %>%
  mutate(texture = recode(lab_texture_lpsa_preliminary, !!!texture_map)) %>%
  mutate( # Use regex to add a space between hue and value/chroma
    color_corrected = gsub("([A-Za-z]+)([0-9]+)", "\\1 \\2", matrix_color),
    # Split color into three parts: Hue, Value, and Chroma
    hue = sapply(strsplit(as.character(color_corrected), " "), function(x) x[1]),
    value_chroma = sapply(strsplit(as.character(color_corrected), " "), function(x) x[2]),
    value = sapply(strsplit(value_chroma, "/"), function(x) x[1]),
    chroma = sapply(strsplit(value_chroma, "/"), function(x) x[2]),
    color = munsell2rgb(the_hue = hue, the_value = value,  # Split the 'color' column into separate hue, value, and chroma components
    the_chroma = chroma, return_triplets=FALSE)) #return triplets is false bc otherwise it gives 3 columns with separate rgb
  
data_frame$rgb_values <- munsell2rgb(the_hue = data_frame$hue,
                                     the_value = as.numeric(data_frame$value),
                                     the_chroma = as.numeric(data_frame$chroma),
                                     return_triplets = TRUE)

data_frame <- data_frame %>%
  mutate(red = rgb_values[, 1],
         green = rgb_values[, 2],
         blue = rgb_values[, 3]) %>%
  dplyr::select(-rgb_values) #remove triplets bc we already have them


data_frame <- data_frame %>%
  mutate(hzid = ifelse(str_starts(hzid, "^"), str_remove(hzid, "\\^"), hzid),
         hzid = str_replace(hzid, "A/E", "AE"),
         hzid = ifelse(hzid == "", NA, hzid),
    depletions = ifelse(depletions == "Yes", 1, 0),
    htm = ifelse(htm == "Yes", 1, 0),
    first_letter = str_sub(hzid, 1, 1),  # Extract the first letter
    first_letter_code = case_when(
      first_letter == "A" ~ 1,  # Assign code 1 for horizon "A"
      first_letter == "B" ~ 2,  # Assign code 2 for horizon "B"
      first_letter == "C" ~ 3,  # Assign code 3 for horizon "C"
      first_letter == "E" ~ 4,  # Assign code 4 for horizon "E"
      TRUE ~ 0                  # Assign code 0 for anything else
    ),
    intermingle_body = ifelse(intermingle_body == "Yes", 1, 0),
    concentrations = ifelse(concentrations == "Yes", 1, 0)) %>%
dplyr::select(point, id, hzid, top, bottom, texture, sand, silt, clay, color, red, green, blue, depletions, concentrations, first_letter_code, htm, intermingle_body, matrix_color) %>% #column selection
arrange(point, id, hzid, top, bottom, texture, clay, sand, silt, color) #order



```

###Datasets:

```{r}
# Create a SoilProfileCollection object:
SPC_df <- data_frame
aqp::depths(SPC_df) <- point ~ top + bottom


#spatial join:
data_spat <- data_frame %>%
  left_join(FPspatial, by = c("point" = "Point_ID"), copy = TRUE)
coords <- as.data.frame(terra::crds(FPspatial))  # extracts X and Y
names(coords) <- c("lon", "lat")  # rename to match what `vect()` expects

FPspatial_df <- as.data.frame(FPspatial)
FPspatial_df <- bind_cols(FPspatial_df, coords)

merged_df <- data_frame %>%
  left_join(FPspatial_df %>% 
              dplyr::select(Point_ID, lon, lat), by = c("point" = "Point_ID"))
names(merged_df)  # should now include "lon" and "lat"

merged_df$lon <- as.numeric(merged_df$lon)
merged_df$lat <- as.numeric(merged_df$lat)
# Remove lat lon rows with NA
merged_df_clean <- merged_df[!is.na(merged_df$lon) & !is.na(merged_df$lat), ]

write.csv(merged_df_clean, "../Data/Full Profile Data/Final_Perry_FP_data_2025_clean.csv", row.names = FALSE)
#save as .gpkg:
st_write(merged_df_clean, "../Data/Full Profile Data/Final_Perry_FP_data_2025_clean.gpkg", layer = "Perry_FP_data", delete_dsn = TRUE)
#SPC_df is the SPC
#data_frame is df
#data_spat and merged_df_clean is spatial obj
```

###Clustering

```{r clustering, message=FALSE}
dissimilarity_matrix <- NCSP(SPC_df,
                             vars = c("sand","silt","clay","red", "green", "blue","top",
                                      "bottom","depletions", "concentrations",
                                      "first_letter_code", "htm", 
                                      "intermingle_body" ), # Use RGB as numeric
                             maxDepth = 150,
                             k = 0.01)
diana <- diana(dissimilarity_matrix)

par(mar = c(1,0,3,1))
plotProfileDendrogram(SPC_df, diana, label = "point",  width=.5, color = "color", cex.name=0.65, scaling.factor = 0.4, id.style = 'top', cex.id = .8, dend.color = 2)

grp <- cutree(diana, k = 10)
#remove profiles from data_frame 
data_frame <- data_frame[!data_frame$point %in% c("59", "80", "49", "79", "57", "48", "40", "81"), ]
df <- data.frame(
  id = unique(data_frame$point),
  cluster = grp)

# Create sf object from data_frame

df_spatial <- merged_df_clean %>%
  left_join(df, by = c("point" = "id")) %>%
  mutate(cluster = as.factor(cluster)) %>%
  sf::st_as_sf(coords = c("lon", "lat"), crs = 3857)

df_spatial$cluster <- as.factor(df_spatial$cluster)

```

```{r Representative Pedon of Each Cluster}
# --- Prepare objects ---
diss <- as.matrix(dissimilarity_matrix)
cluster_assignments <- grp

# Make sure the pedon IDs used by grp match the dissimilarity matrix rownames
pedon_ids <- names(cluster_assignments)
if (is.null(pedon_ids)) pedon_ids <- rownames(diss)

# Representative pedon (medoid) per cluster
get_medoid <- function(cluster_id) {

  members <- pedon_ids[cluster_assignments == cluster_id]
  members <- members[members %in% rownames(diss)]  # safety

  # If cluster has 0 or 1 member, return it
  if (length(members) == 0) return(NA_character_)
  if (length(members) == 1) return(members[1])

  sub_diss <- diss[members, members, drop = FALSE]  # <- key fix
  mean_dist <- rowMeans(sub_diss, na.rm = TRUE)

  members[which.min(mean_dist)]
}

clusters <- sort(unique(cluster_assignments))

representative_pedons <- tibble::tibble(
  cluster = clusters,
  rep_pedon = purrr::map_chr(clusters, get_medoid),
  n_in_cluster = purrr::map_int(clusters, ~ sum(cluster_assignments == .x, na.rm = TRUE))
)

representative_pedons


```

```{r}
# --- You already have these from earlier ---
diss <- as.matrix(dissimilarity_matrix)
cluster_assignments <- grp

# If diss rownames are not the pedon IDs, stop and fix that first
# (they should match names(grp) or profile_id(SPC_df))
rownames(diss)[1:5]

# --- Define your anchor clusters (edit if you want) ---
anchor_clusters <- c(1, 4, 5)  # core + wet; remove 6/7 if you only want 1/2/4

# --- Get medoid for each anchor cluster (robust) ---
pedon_ids <- names(cluster_assignments)
if (is.null(pedon_ids)) pedon_ids <- rownames(diss)

get_medoid <- function(cluster_id) {
  members <- pedon_ids[cluster_assignments == cluster_id]
  members <- members[members %in% rownames(diss)]
  if (length(members) == 0) return(NA_character_)
  if (length(members) == 1) return(members[1])
  sub_diss <- diss[members, members, drop = FALSE]
  mean_dist <- rowMeans(sub_diss, na.rm = TRUE)
  members[which.min(mean_dist)]
}

anchor_medoids <- setNames(
  purrr::map_chr(anchor_clusters, get_medoid),
  paste0("cluster_", anchor_clusters)
)

anchor_medoids
# (should show something like cluster_1 = "9", cluster_2 = "61", cluster_4 = "38", ...)

# --- Function: compute distances from a pedon to each anchor medoid ---
dist_to_anchors <- function(pedon_id) {
  pedon_id <- as.character(pedon_id)
  if (!pedon_id %in% rownames(diss)) stop("Pedon not found in diss rownames: ", pedon_id)

  d <- sapply(anchor_medoids, function(m) diss[pedon_id, m])
  tibble::tibble(
    pedon = pedon_id,
    anchor = names(d),
    anchor_medoid = unname(anchor_medoids),
    diss = as.numeric(d)
  ) %>%
    dplyr::arrange(diss) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(rank = dplyr::row_number())
}

# --- Run for your questionable pedons ---
questionable <- c("10", "26", "25", "35")

results <- purrr::map_dfr(questionable, dist_to_anchors)
results
summary_assign <- results %>%
  dplyr::group_by(pedon) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(
    best_anchor = anchor[1],
    best_medoid = anchor_medoid[1],
    best_diss = diss[1],
    second_diss = diss[2],
    gap = second_diss - best_diss,
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  dplyr::arrange(pedon)

summary_assign

```

###Random Forest

```{r Random Forest}
border <- terra::rast(vect("../Data/covariates/border/border.shp"))
  USGS_DEM = terra::rast("../Data/covariates/output_USGS1m.tif")
  clipped_stack = terra::rast("../Data/covariates/clipped_stack.tif")
  pca_SR = terra::rast("../Data/covariates/pca_SR.tif")
  NDVI = terra::rast("../Data/covariates/NDVI.tif")

#project border to covariates:
border <- terra::project(border, USGS_DEM)
border_ext <-ext(border)

USGS_DEM <- terra::crop(USGS_DEM, border_ext)
clipped_stack <- terra::crop(clipped_stack, border_ext)
pca_SR <- terra::crop(pca_SR, border_ext)
NDVI <- terra::crop(NDVI, border_ext)
USGS_DEM_aligned <- resample(crop(USGS_DEM, NDVI), NDVI)
pca_SR_aligned   <- resample(crop(pca_SR, NDVI), NDVI)
clipped_stack_aligned <- resample(crop(clipped_stack, NDVI), NDVI)
covariates_stack <- c(NDVI, USGS_DEM_aligned, pca_SR_aligned, clipped_stack_aligned)

# names(covariates) <- c(
#   "USGS_DEM",
#   "clipped_stack",
#   "pca_SR",
#   "NDVI"
# )

#set clusters as follows: 4 and 6 are 4, 5 and 10 are 5, and 7,8,9,11 are 6:
df_spatialt$cluster <- case_when(
  df_spatialt$cluster == 1 ~ 1,
  df_spatialt$cluster == 2 ~ 2,
  df_spatialt$cluster == 3 ~ 3,
  df_spatialt$cluster == 4 ~ 3,
  df_spatialt$cluster == 5 ~ 4,
  df_spatialt$cluster == 6 ~ 3,
  df_spatialt$cluster == 7 ~ 5,
  df_spatialt$cluster == 8 ~ 5,
  df_spatialt$cluster == 9 ~ 5,
  df_spatialt$cluster == 10 ~ 4,
  df_spatialt$cluster == 11 ~ 5
)

# Extract raster values at soil sample points
extractFP <- terra::extract(covariates_stack, df_spatialt, bind = TRUE) %>%
  as.data.frame(geom = "XY") %>%
  mutate(
    hzid = as.factor(hzid),
    matrix_color = as.factor(matrix_color))

df_response<-df_spatialt %>%
  dplyr::select(point,cluster) %>%
  distinct() %>%
  dplyr::select(cluster)

extractFP<-terra::extract(covariates_stack, df_response, ID = F) %>%
  cbind(df_response) %>%
  dplyr::select(!geometry) %>%
  #set cluster as a factor
  mutate(cluster = as.factor(cluster))


set.seed(626) # Set seed for reproducibility
# extractFP <- extractFP %>%
#   dplyr::select(-texture, -red, -green, -blue, -id, -point, -sand, -silt, -clay, -color) # Ensure cluster is a factor

data_split <- initial_split(extractFP, prop = 0.8, strata = cluster)

train_data <- training(data_split)

test_data <- testing(data_split)

#check distributions:
ggplot() +
  geom_density(data = train_data, 
               aes(x = cluster),
               color = "red") +
  geom_density(data = test_data, 
               aes(x = cluster),
               color = "blue") 

df_recipe <- recipe(cluster ~ ., data = train_data) %>%
  step_normalize(all_numeric_predictors()) %>%
  step_impute_knn(all_predictors(), neighbors = 5)

df_prep <- df_recipe %>%
  prep()

df_prep

#train_data <- bake(df_prep, new_data = NULL)

#specify the model
rf_model <- rand_forest(
  trees = tune(),
  mtry = tune(),
  min_n = tune(),
  mode = "classification"
) %>%
  set_engine("ranger", importance = "impurity")
#resampling strategy:
resampling_foldcv <- vfold_cv(training(data_split), v = 5, strata = cluster)

#tune the model:
rf_metrics <- metric_set(accuracy)

ctrl <- control_sim_anneal(save_pred = TRUE)

rf_grid_result <- tune_sim_anneal(
  object = rf_model,
  preprocessor = df_recipe,
  resamples = resampling_foldcv,
  iter = 100,
  control = ctrl,
  metrics = rf_metrics
)

beepr::beep("wilhelm")

#plot(rf_grid_result)
rf_grid_result %>%
  collect_metrics() %>%
  filter(.metric == "accuracy") %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = mtry, y = mean)) +
  geom_line() +
  geom_point() +
  labs(title = "Random Forest Hyperparameter Tuning",
       x = "Number of Variables Tried at Each Split (mtry)",
       y = "Mean Accuracy")

#best params:
best_params <- show_best(rf_grid_result, metric = "accuracy", n = 1)

#final model:
rf_model_final <- finalize_model(rf_model, best_params)
rf_fit <- rf_model_final %>%
  fit(cluster ~ ., data = train_data)
rf_fit

#predict:
test_baked <- bake(df_prep, new_data = test_data)

rf_predictions <- rf_fit %>%
  predict(new_data = test_data) %>%
  bind_cols(test_data)


#roc-auc validation

rf_predictions %>%
  roc_auc(truth = cluster, .pred_class) %>%
  mutate(.metric = "roc_auc") %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = .metric, y = .estimate)) +
  geom_col() +
  labs(title = "ROC AUC for Random Forest Model",
       x = "Metric",
       y = "Value") +
  theme_minimal()

#plot predictions:
rf_predictions %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = cluster, y = .pred_class)) +
  geom_jitter() +
  labs(title = "Random Forest Predictions vs Actual",
       x = "Actual Cluster",
       y = "Predicted Cluster") +
  theme_minimal()

#plot map: (this only plots test data.. need to figure out how to plot the whole map)
leaflet(rf_predictions) %>%
  addProviderTiles(providers$Esri.WorldTopoMap) %>%
  addCircleMarkers(
    lng = ~x,     # use your x column as longitude
    lat = ~y,     # use your y column as latitude
    color = ~cluster_colors[as.numeric(.pred_class)],
    label = ~paste("Cluster:", cluster),
    radius = 5,
    fillOpacity = 0.7
  )

rf_predict_spatrast<-predict(rf_fit,covariates_stack)

prediction_rast<-rast(covariates_stack$NDVI)

values(prediction_rast)<- NA

names(prediction_rast) <- NA

values(prediction_rast) <- rf_predict_spatrast

#plot map:

plot(prediction_rast)

leaflet() %>%
  addProviderTiles(providers$Esri.WorldTopoMap) %>%
  addRasterImage(rf_predict_spatrast$predictions, 
                 colors = cluster_colors,
                 opacity = 0.5)
```

```{r}


predict_clusters_fun <- function(pixel_vector) {
  # pixel_vector: numeric vector with length = number of raster layers (covariates)
  
  # If any NA in pixel_vector, return NA (no prediction)
  if (any(is.na(pixel_vector))) return(NA)
  
  # Convert to data frame with 1 row, colnames = covariates_stack names
  newdata <- as.data.frame(t(pixel_vector))
  colnames(newdata) <- names(covariates_stack)
  
  # Preprocess with your recipe
  newdata_prep <- bake(df_prep, new_data = newdata)
  
  # Predict cluster (class)
  pred <- predict(rf_fit, newdata_prep, type = "class")
  
  # Convert factor to numeric cluster
  as.numeric(as.factor(pred$.pred_class))
}
extractFP <- terra::extract(covariates_stack, df_spatialt, bind = TRUE)
# Apply prediction function to raster stack using terra::app()
pred_raster <- app(rast(extractFP), fun = predict_clusters_fun)

# Plot result with cluster colors
plot(pred_raster, col = cluster_colors, main = "Predicted Clusters via terra::app()")
legend("topright", legend = levels(as.factor(rf_fit$trainingData$.outcome)),
       fill = cluster_colors, title = "Cluster")

```

predict_clusters_fun <- function(pixel_vector) {
  # pixel_vector: numeric vector with length = number of raster layers (covariates)
  
  # If any NA in pixel_vector, return NA (no prediction)
  if (any(is.na(pixel_vector))) return(NA)
  
  # Convert to data frame with 1 row, colnames = covariates_stack names
  newdata <- as.data.frame(t(pixel_vector))
  colnames(newdata) <- names(covariates_stack)
  
  # Preprocess with your recipe
  newdata_prep <- bake(df_prep, new_data = newdata)
  
  # Predict cluster (class)
  pred <- predict(rf_fit, newdata_prep, type = "class")
  
  # Convert factor to numeric cluster
  as.numeric(as.factor(pred$.pred_class))
}
extractFP <- terra::extract(covariates_stack, df_spatialt, bind = TRUE)
# Apply prediction function to raster stack using terra::app()
pred_raster <- app(rast(extractFP), fun = predict_clusters_fun)

# Plot result with cluster colors
plot(pred_raster, col = cluster_colors, main = "Predicted Clusters via terra::app()")
legend("topright", legend = levels(as.factor(rf_fit$trainingData$.outcome)),
       fill = cluster_colors, title = "Cluster")
